landing.title: Turn every physical location into a measurable feedback channel.
landing.lede: Godwit helps venues turn a simple QR scan into feedback, campaign insight, and permission-based follow-up.
landing.note: Built for venues, events, hospitality, retail, and in-person teams.
landing.howItWorksTitle: From a QR code to a better decision.

steps.step1Detail: Use one branded QR poster at a table, counter, room, or event entrance - for a poll, an info card, or a donation ask.
steps.step2Detail: Guests scan, choose an answer, and submit. No download or account is needed.
steps.step3Detail: Use answer patterns to invite honest public reviews, offer a benefit, and learn what brings customers back.

landing.outcomesTitle: Build a stronger connection after every response.

outcomes.reusableDetail: Keep the same printed QR code while changing the active poll.
outcomes.conversionDetail: Compare scans with completed votes to see where engagement happens.
outcomes.growthDetail: Invite voters to share their email for event news and offers only after clear consent.
outcomes.publicDetail: Send selected responses to Google, Tripadvisor, or another review platform with an optional voucher or discount code.
outcomes.connectionDetail: Reward email opt-ins immediately and verify external review claims before releasing the second benefit.
outcomes.donationsDetail: The same QR code can also collect tips or donations for your venue, processed securely through Stripe.

landing.flockTitle: Every part of Godwit has its own character.
landing.flockLede: Seven specialists working together — each named after a bird, each with one job to do well.

flock.robinDetail: Walks brand-new workspaces through their first poll, first QR code, and first vote — no manual required.
flock.redshankDetail: Routes low-score feedback to a private message before it ever reaches Google, Booking, or Tripadvisor.
flock.magpieDetail: Pulls responses from every QR location and campaign into one place, so nothing gets missed.
flock.flamingoDetail: Shows off your strongest feedback in a polished, public-facing display guests actually enjoy reading.
flock.ternDetail: One scan, one question, one honest answer — surveys light enough for a busy counter or doorway.
flock.waxwingDetail: Prize draws, redemption tracking, donations, and automated nurture emails for workspaces ready to grow faster.
flock.owlDetail: Keeps an eye on your brand, your team's access, and your plan, quietly, until something needs your attention.

landing.finalTitle: Launch your first QR feedback campaign.
landing.finalCopy: Set up your workspace, create a QR feedback campaign, and turn customer responses into your next decision.

connection.title: Turn one QR scan into an ongoing relationship.
connection.subtitle: Use this page as your checklist. Ask for an email only with clear consent, invite selected voters to leave honest public feedback, and release benefits according to your configured rules.

step1.title: Configure the offer
step1.body: Add Google, Tripadvisor, or another honest review destination when creating a poll, and set the benefit voters unlock for voting. Every voter sees the same review link regardless of their answer - gating it by sentiment would break Google/Tripadvisor's rules.

step2.title: Collect permission
step2.body: Voters can voluntarily share their email after voting. Use the email settings below to send event news, offers, or a follow-up message.

step3.title: Verify and reward
step3.body: Check pending claims in the review queue. Approve the benefit only after confirming the voter left honest feedback on the selected platform.

whatCustomerSees.title: What the customer sees
whatCustomerSees.voteBody: They scan the QR code and answer without creating an account.
whatCustomerSees.stayConnectedBody: They choose whether to share an email for follow-up and benefits.
whatCustomerSees.shareHonestlyBody: Every voter, whatever they answered, receives your review links and can submit a verification claim.
whatCustomerSees.disclaimer: Do not require or script a positive review. Benefits should be offered transparently and review requests should invite honest feedback.

connection.emailDeliveryNote: Delivery requires the RESEND_API_KEY and REPORT_FROM_EMAIL server settings, same as weekly reports.

leadNurture.title: Lead nurture emails
leadNurture.description: Automatically email voters who opted in for follow-up (or a prize draw) right after they vote.
leadNurture.subjectPlaceholder: Email subject: Thanks for your feedback!
leadNurture.lockedDescription: You're collecting emails already - turn them into repeat visits with an automatic thank-you email, no manual work required.

winback.title: Win-back emails
winback.description: Automatically email a voter who left their email and consented, but hasn't voted again after the number of days below. This only reaches people who opted in - voting itself always stays anonymous.
winback.lockedTitle: Win back customers who've gone quiet
winback.lockedDescription: Automatically re-engage voters who haven't come back in a while, without manually tracking who's overdue.

intro.eyebrow: What a QR code can hold
intro.title: One printed code, three kinds of content.
intro.body: A QR code isn't just a shortcut to one poll. Scan it and a voter can see one or more polls, an info card (menu, hours, bio, exhibit notes...), and a donation ask — all in the same code. Set up donations first below, then build the code itself under "QR campaigns".

scanner.title: Scan a QR code
scanner.subtitle: Already holding a printed QR code? Scan it to see which poll it uses right now, and switch it to another poll instantly.
scanner.pastePlaceholder: Or paste the QR link here
scanner.redirectLabel: Redirect this QR code to another poll
scanner.createNewPoll: Create a new poll for this QR code

donations.title: Donations
donations.description: Let voters support your venue with a card or wallet payment from the QR menu. Connect a Stripe account once here, then add a "Donation" item to any QR code below. Stripe processes the payment: 90% transfers straight to your account and Godwit keeps a 10% platform fee.
donations.stripeConnected: Stripe is connected and ready to accept donations.
donations.stripeStarted: Stripe account started, but onboarding isn't finished yet.
donations.messagePlaceholder: Optional thank-you message shown with the donation option
donations.feeNote: Stripe is the payment processor - Godwit never sees or stores card details. Of each donation, 10% is a platform fee retained by Godwit and 90% transfers to your connected Stripe account.

locations.title: QR locations
locations.subtitle: Create reusable QR locations, then point each location at the poll currently running there.

campaigns.title: QR campaigns
campaigns.description: Create a durable QR code per placement to measure scans, responses, and opted-in follow-up leads. Each one starts with a default poll below, but open "Items on this QR code" on any campaign to add more polls, an info card, or a donation ask.
campaigns.tip: Tip: open a printed QR code while signed in to see its name and poll, and change them directly.
campaigns.bulkGenerate: Generate multiple QR codes at once
campaigns.bulkGenerateNote: Creates "Table 1", "Table 2"... You can scan or open each one later to assign or change its poll.
campaigns.itemsHint: Add one or more polls, info cards, and a donation ask here to turn this QR code into a menu: scanning it will show everything listed below at once, instead of going straight to a single poll.
